name: Cassava-leaf soup
summary: Stir-fried cassava leaf stirred with rice-flour water until it thickens into a soft, porridge-like soup.
origin: The Krông Pa cassava-leaf article names canh lá mì as a second dish from the leaf the Jrai already stir-fry.
howToEat: Stir-fry the leaves until cooked, then pour in rice-flour water and stir until the flour cooks and thickens like porridge.
seoDescription: Canh lá mì is stir-fried cassava leaf thickened with rice-flour water into a porridge-like soup. A Jrai dish from Krông Pa.
